S7_logprob.purpose: OPTIONAL: forced-choice token logprobs = P(Jerry) vs P(George). Phase-1 metric preview, no GPU needed. Only on s7_eligible models. NOTE: the `logprobs` flag below records that OpenRouter ADVERTISES logprobs for the model — verified 2026-08-03 that this does NOT mean the serving provider returns them (of 5 llama-3.1-8b endpoints, 3 return an empty array and 1 returns only the terminal token). The runner therefore probes empirically for a logprob-capable endpoint per model and pins S7 to it separately from the behavioral pin; if none works, S7 is skipped for that model and the skip is printed and recorded. Also: S7 runs at temperature 0, so its n=3 is a provider-determinism check, not statistical power.

S8_premise_grid.purpose: THE GENERALISATION RUN. All 8 frozen conflict items x {correct, lure} premise. S4/S5 on SEIN-001 alone showed 4 of 5 models accept a FALSE premise 8/8 while only kimi-k3 corrects it; this tests whether that regime holds item-wide, and whether it extends to the 3 REAL-PERSON role inversions (SPORT-102, HIST-103, HIST-104) which are the Brian Hood analog. n=5 matches gen01 convention. Authors no new text - all prompts are frozen item fields.
